title: croatian flatbread pizza
description: salty and energizing croatian dish featuring cilantro leaves and no eggs, perfect for a quick and easy snack

ingredients.name: warm water
ingredients.notes: about 1 1/2 cups or enough to form a dough

instructions: mix flour and salt in a bowl, then gradually add in warm water to form a dough
knead the dough for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic
divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired pizza size
roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/4 inch thick
heat a tagine pot or skillet over medium-high heat, then brush with olive oil
cook each pizza for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown
top each pizza with chopped cilantro, cumin seeds, and coriander seeds
